subject: POC prompt dataset & eval plan (AcmeHealth)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 17:32:00 +0000
Subject: POC prompt dataset & eval plan (AcmeHealth)

Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: run a 2-4 week POC to validate Redwood inference against AcmeHealth's production prompts and logs.
- Scope: generation/chat use cases (patient messaging assistant + triage summarization).

Proposed success criteria (we can refine):
1) Latency: p95 end-to-end inference < 300ms for typical prompts (under your baseline seq lengths)
2) Quality: >= 85% pass rate on the evaluation rubric we discussed (relevance + correctness; we will provide rubric template)
3) Cost/throughput: projected cost per 1M tokens < $X (we'll model after run)

What we need from AcmeHealth to build the eval dataset:
- 100-200 representative prompts (input texts) covering top categories (triage, follow-up, scheduling, admin)
- ~50 labeled examples with expected outputs (gold responses) for scoring
- Optional: 1-2 weeks of anonymized logs (sample of input/output pairs) - if not shareable, pseudo-anonymized versions are fine

Format preference: CSV or JSONL with columns: id, prompt_text, expected_output (optional), category, sensitivity_flag
If you already have a schema, send that and we can adapt.

Ownership & timeline (proposed):
- May 12: Acme sends initial prompt set + labeled examples
- May 19: Redwood runs baseline eval and shares results + model variant recommendations
- May 26: POC report with recommended config, cost estimate, and next steps

Tech contact: Aditya Rao (cc'd) will handle ingestion and environment setup.
Commercial/Escalation: Rishi Malhotra (cc'd).

Next steps for you: can you share the sample prompts and confirm who will be the Acme owner for this data handoff? Also let us know if there are any compliance constraints (PII, HIPAA redaction requirements) we should be aware of up front.

Thanks - looking forward to running this.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan (AcmeHealth)

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. That timeline works in general. We can own shipping an initial set of prompts and labeled examples. Sara Nguyen (patient-engagement lead) will be the data owner on our side; I’m cc'ing her on a separate thread.

A few items/ask from our side before we push data: 
- We need confirmation on how Redwood will handle PHI/PII during the POC. Can you confirm encryption at rest and that data will not be used beyond the POC?
- Is a simple NDA amendment required? We have a standard DPA in place but want to be explicit about logs.

Attached: acme_prompt_samples.csv (sample prompts, small subset) and acme_infra_requirements.pdf (our infra/security checklist).

We will aim to deliver the full set by Tue May 12. Confirming we’ll pseudo-anonymize logs where needed; if Redwood prefers pre-redacted examples we can do that.

Thanks - Tom
Senior Product Manager, AcmeHealth

Attachments:
- acme_prompt_samples.csv (text/csv)
- acme_infra_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan (AcmeHealth)

Tom / Marissa -

Quick technical checklist to make ingestion smooth: 
- Preferred upload: S3 bucket (we can provide presigned URLs) or secure Google Drive share.
- Max file size: 500MB per file. For large logs provide split files or JSONL streams.
- Accepted schemas: CSV (id,prompt_text,expected_output,category,sensitivity_flag) or JSONL (one object per line).
- Logs: if you can replace patient identifiers with stable pseudonyms (user_123) that’s ideal; timestamps are okay to keep relative.
- Encryption: we will accept files encrypted at rest in your bucket; presigned uploads to Redwood ingestion endpoint will be over TLS and stored in an encrypted bucket under the POC project.

I can spin up an S3 ingestion location and share presigned PUT URLs by EOD once you confirm. Also attaching (inline reference) our small ingest checklist and a sample preprocessing script we use to normalize CSV -> JSONL for eval.

If you expect to include multi-turn chat transcripts, please include a conversation_id field so we can reconstruct context windows.

I’ll be the technical lead for the POC on the Redwood side.

Thanks - Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan (AcmeHealth)

Thanks team - small clarifications so we have measurable evaluation outputs: 

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Baseline: run Acme prompts against a baseline open model + our recommended optimized variant(s).
- Metrics: task-specific accuracy (where gold labels available), relevance score (human rated sample), hallucination rate (automated heuristics + spot-check), latency distribution (p50/p95), and cost per 1M tokens.
- Runs: we’ll do an initial run (single-shot) and a second run with context-window tuned caching/batching to show ops improvements.

Success criteria acceptance: we’ll deliver a short rubric and a checklist for your reviewers. If >=85% of labeled examples pass the rubric and latency SLOs are met, we’ll mark the POC successful.

Proposed timeline (confirmable):
- May 12: Acme delivers dataset (100-200 prompts + 50 labels + sample logs)
- May 19: Redwood shares baseline eval + model variant recommendations + demo
- May 26: Final POC report + recommended deployment config and cost modeling

Action items / owners:
- Acme: deliver dataset + confirm redaction approach (Tom / Sara) - due May 12
- Redwood SE: ingestion and baseline eval (Aditya) - deliver May 19
- Redwood Sales/Product: POC success criteria and commercial next steps (Marissa / Rishi)

Please confirm timelines and whether May 12 works for delivery. If you need additional compliance paperwork, flag it and we'll loop Legal.

Best,
Marissa
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan (AcmeHealth)

Marissa / Aditya -

Confirming May 12 delivery. We will: 
- Send the full prompt set (CSV) and the labeled examples by EOD May 12 to the presigned S3 location (or Drive link if you prefer).
- Pseudo-anonymize logs (replace patient ids with stable pseudonyms).
- Include a short mapping document describing categories and the expected output format.

Attaching the small sample we discussed for your review (acme_prompt_samples.csv) and our infra checklist (acme_infra_requirements.pdf). For the full drop we may zip the files if large.

On the compliance question: we are happy to sign an addendum that explicitly limits data usage to the POC and requires deletion upon completion. Please send a pointer if Redwood has a standard addendum; otherwise we'll coordinate with Legal.

Thanks - Tom
